|game_text=Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. May not be targeted by weapons unless your other slavers present are each ‘hit.’ Permanent weapon is •[[Bossk's Mortar Gun]] (may target a character for free; draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny = target's destiny number).
|errata_history=This is the original printed text; the images are its release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image. The later errata version is [[Bossk With Mortar Gun (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of May 11, 2012"; this copy was re-made on 18 July 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. May not be targeted by weapons unless your other slavers present are each ‘hit.’ Permanent weapon is •Bossk's Mortar Gun (may target a character for free; draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny = target's destiny number).” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-03-Bossk_With_Mortar_Gun.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-bosskwithmortargun-pre.gif]]) print it. The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>; that copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Bossk With Mortar Gun (V) (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) has “each 'hit'. Permanent” instead of “each ‘hit.’ Permanent”, “(may target a character for free. Draw destiny. Target hit and forfeit =0, if destiny matches target's destiny number)” instead of “(may target a character for free; draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny = target's destiny number)” (the pilot icon written out as “Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots.”)<ref name="cl-1281_4-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive); same text in every capture to [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-01-11]</ref>: “Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. May not be targeted by weapons unless your other slavers present are each 'hit'. Permanent weapon is •Bossk's Mortar Gun (may target a character for free. Draw destiny. Target hit and forfeit =0, if destiny matches target's destiny number).” No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB8-03-Bossk_With_Mortar_Gun-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
